structured_plan.G: Keep the supplied candidate.cpp unchanged as the initial G. After research, compare only correct measured candidates, test combinations rather than assuming additive gains, and independently confirm the selected final program.
structured_plan.analysis: Choose N=3 for complementary single-core approaches: SIMD acceleration of ASCII runs, full SIMD validation of mixed-width UTF-8 structure, and a scalar table-driven DFA. The supplied baseline is reported correct; its three search measurements average 51.46 µs for n=65536. Treat that as a search baseline, not an independent confirmation. Preserve exact UTF-8 scalar-value rules, bounds safety for every input, the run signature, full uint32 output writes, and the threads budget. Performance judgment should use comparable measurements on valid mixed-width text while retaining malformed and ASCII correctness checks.

children.objective: Explore block-level ASCII detection (for example, safe word- or vector-sized high-bit tests) to skip ASCII runs, falling back to the supplied scalar validation logic for non-ASCII bytes. Optimize mixed input without assuming its ASCII fraction or reading beyond n. Keep this focused on ASCII-run skipping rather than implementing a full SIMD UTF-8 validator; measure speed and preserve correctness on all malformed and valid inputs.
children.subject: Fast ASCII-run scanning

children.objective: Explore a one-pass SIMD validator that checks byte classes and neighboring-byte continuation relationships across blocks, including overlong encodings, surrogates, values above U+10FFFF, and truncated sequences. Handle block boundaries and tails safely for arbitrary n; do not rely on benchmark contents. Measure valid mixed-width performance and verify all correctness cases.
children.subject: Full SIMD UTF-8 validation

children.objective: Explore a scalar table-driven finite-state validator or equivalent branch-reduced scalar state machine, without SIMD. Encode all UTF-8 lead, continuation, and special-range constraints and handle end-of-input in every state. Keep the work distinct from ASCII block scanning and vectorized validation; measure valid mixed-width performance and verify all correctness cases.
children.subject: Scalar table-driven DFA
